messages.subject: please help - map rotation problem
parts:

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Re: please help - map rotation problem
parts:
Hi Scott,

I wondered if you have the x and y coordinates the wrong way 'round? Also, if
you have a complicated shape, you can run into problems if the coordinates are
not in the "right" order (see page 9 of the shapefile specification, at
http://www.esri.com/library/whitepapers/pdfs/shapefile.pdf) - but I don't
think this is the problem in your case. If you can't figure it out from the
above then send me a copy of your project (File | Export as zip).

- Len
